protocol: Windowing parameters fit on dev by grid search, applied unchanged to eval. L2/L3 use S2's own batsman selection, so 'all clips' is end-to-end; identity-conditioned results restrict to clips where S2 picked the annotated batsman.
l0_note: L0 is the whole clip: the production pipeline has no intra-clip shot localizer -- select_phase_frames is handed start/end from the external ingestion step.
multi_shot_note: MULTIPLE_SHOTS clips carry no per-shot boundaries, so 'interval contains >1 event' is not computable. Reported proxy: did the method emit an interval.
